name: Atropos
source:
For a long time, the kingdom of Capernaum has been ruled by the Khrushch dynasty - powerful beetles that rule over other insects. Atropos, the crown prince, decides not to wait for his father's death, but to take power by force.

On the way to the throne, intrigues, difficulties and obstacles await him. Will Atropos be able to defeat his enemies, overthrow his father and become the head of the kingdom?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
长期以来，迦百农王国一直由赫鲁晓王朝统治——强大的甲虫统治着其他昆虫。王储阿特罗波斯决定不坐等父亲去世，而是以武力夺取政权。

在登上王位的路上，阴谋、艰难险阻等待着他。阿特罗波斯能否击败他的敌人，推翻他的父亲并成为王国的元首？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383640/]Steam[/url]]
